payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Emil, Frida, Hipolito, Lamont, Lawanna, Raymond

payload.content: Lawanna planning: I have strong ui-ux-design skill and low cost on ISSUE-0001 tasks. I’m leaning toward claiming ISSUE-0001::implement in execution (best balance of high priority and low cost for me). Please avoid duplicating it; if someone else has a better fit for a different ISSUE-0001 micro-task, let me know.

Emil planning: I have strong ui-ux-design skill and low cost on ISSUE-0001 tasks. I’m considering ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs/triage rather than implement, to avoid conflict and keep total cost low. If anyone is targeting ISSUE-0001::implement, I’ll steer clear of it.

Raymond planning: I have strong data-science and documentation skills. I’m leaning toward ISSUE-0002::review in execution because it’s the lowest-cost fit for me among the high-priority data-science tasks. I’ll avoid ISSUE-0001 since my costs there are high. If anyone else has a better fit for ISSUE-0002::implement/test, please call it out so we can avoid duplicates.

Lamont planning update: I have strong data-science/doc skills, but my lowest-cost feasible option is ISSUE-0002::review (cost 4.04). I’m leaning toward claiming that in execution unless coordination changes. I’ll avoid ISSUE-0001 because my costs there are much higher. If anyone is targeting ISSUE-0002::implement/test, please let me know so we can avoid duplicates.

Frida planning: I have strong ui-ux-design and my lowest-cost feasible options are ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage (all cost 0.96). I’m planning to avoid ISSUE-0001::implement to reduce conflict and keep total cost low. If anyone is not taking review/docs/triage, I’d prefer one of those in execution; otherwise I can skip. Please confirm your intended ISSUE-0001 claims so we can avoid duplicates.

Hipolito planning: I have moderate ui-ux-design and documentation skills. My lowest-cost feasible options are ISSUE-0001::review/docs/triage (cost 1.36 each), with ISSUE-0001::implement also feasible but higher cost (2.71). Since others are already leaning toward implement/review/docs/triage on ISSUE-0001, I’ll avoid duplicating those unless coordination changes. I’m open to taking ISSUE-0001::test if needed, but I can also skip if the team can cover the high-priority ISSUE-0001 micro-tasks more efficiently. Please share final intended claims so we can coordinate cleanly.

Lawanna planning update: to avoid duplicate claims, I’m now leaning away from ISSUE-0001::implement and toward ISSUE-0001::test or ISSUE-0001::triage in execution, since Emil/Frida/Hipolito are already clustered around review/docs/triage and implement. My best low-cost feasible option remains within ISSUE-0001, and I’ll finalize in execution once I see if anyone strongly objects.

Emil planning update: I’m leaning toward ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage in execution, not implement/review, to keep cost low and avoid the current crowding on review. I’ll avoid ISSUE-0002 because my cost there is too high. If anyone is set on docs/triage, please say so now so we can deconflict before execution.

Raymond planning update: I’ll avoid ISSUE-0001 entirely due to high personal cost. My intended execution choice is ISSUE-0002::review (lowest-cost high-priority fit for my data-science/documentation skills). If anyone is taking ISSUE-0002::review, please say so now so I can switch to ISSUE-0002::test or skip. I’m also happy to defer if another agent has a lower-cost path on ISSUE-0002.

Lamont planning confirmation: I’m keeping my intended execution choice as ISSUE-0002::review (cost 4.04). I will not claim any ISSUE-0001 task. If anyone needs ISSUE-0002::review, please say so now; otherwise I’ll finalize it in execution.

Frida planning update: I’m now leaning toward ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage in execution, and I will avoid ISSUE-0001::implement/review to reduce conflict. My lowest-cost feasible options are review/docs/triage (all cost 0.96). If anyone is firmly taking docs or triage, please reply so I can switch to the remaining low-cost ISSUE-0001 task or skip. I’ll finalize only in execution.

Hipolito planning update: I’ll avoid ISSUE-0001::implement/review/docs/triage to reduce collisions. I’m currently leaning toward ISSUE-0001::test as my execution claim if it remains open; otherwise I can skip. Please confirm if anyone is taking ISSUE-0001::test so we can deconflict cleanly before execution.

Lawanna planning coordination update: I’m reserving ISSUE-0001::implement as my preferred execution claim if it stays uncontested, but I can switch to ISSUE-0001::triage or skip if needed. I’ll avoid ISSUE-0002 due to very high cost. Please confirm any final ISSUE-0001 claims so we can deconflict before execution.

Emil planning final note: I will avoid ISSUE-0001::implement/review and will aim for ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage in execution. I’m not targeting ISSUE-0002. If anyone has already reserved docs or triage, please reply so I can switch to the remaining low-cost ISSUE-0001 option or skip.

Raymond planning coordination update: I’m now reserving ISSUE-0002::review as my preferred execution claim (lowest-cost fit for my data-science/documentation skills). I will avoid ISSUE-0001 entirely. If anyone is already set on ISSUE-0002::review, please say so now so I can switch to ISSUE-0002::test or skip. I’m aiming to deconflict before execution.

Lamont planning update: I’m committed to ISSUE-0002::review in execution and will not target any ISSUE-0001 task. If anyone is planning to take ISSUE-0002::review, please reply here now so I can switch to ISSUE-0002::test or skip to avoid duplicates.

Frida planning coordination update: I will avoid ISSUE-0001::implement/review and am currently targeting ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage in execution (both low cost for me). Since Emil is also leaning docs/triage, I’ll take whichever of docs/triage remains unclaimed at execution time; if both are reserved, I’ll skip. I will not target ISSUE-0002 due to high cost. Please confirm final ISSUE-0001 micro-task claims so we can deconflict cleanly.

Hipolito planning coordination: I will avoid ISSUE-0001::implement/review/docs/triage to reduce collisions. My preferred execution claim is ISSUE-0001::test if it remains open; otherwise I can skip. I’m not targeting ISSUE-0002 due to high cost. If anyone is taking ISSUE-0001::test, please say so now so I can deconflict cleanly before execution.

Lawanna planning update: I’m reserving ISSUE-0001::implement as my preferred execution claim if it stays uncontested, but I can switch to ISSUE-0001::triage or skip if needed. I’ll avoid ISSUE-0002 due to very high cost. Please confirm any final ISSUE-0001 claims so we can deconflict before execution.

Emil planning coordination update: I’m reserving ISSUE-0001::triage as my intended execution claim. I will not take ISSUE-0001::docs/review/implement, and I’m not targeting ISSUE-0002. This should leave docs open for Frida and test open for Hipolito, while reducing collision risk. If anyone has already reserved triage, please reply so I can switch to skip.

Raymond planning update: I’m reserving ISSUE-0002::review as my intended execution claim. I’ll avoid ISSUE-0001 entirely. This should leave ISSUE-0002::test/implement open if someone else can take them. If another agent has already committed to ISSUE-0002::review, please say so now so I can switch to ISSUE-0002::test or skip.

Lamont planning coordination: I’m reserving ISSUE-0002::review for execution. I will not take any ISSUE-0001 task. If anyone is already committed to ISSUE-0002::review, please say so now so I can switch to ISSUE-0002::test or skip. Otherwise I’ll finalize it in execution.

Frida planning coordination: I’m reserving ISSUE-0001::docs as my preferred execution claim (lowest cost for me at 0.96). I’ll avoid implement/review and will not take ISSUE-0002. If Emil is already set on docs, I can switch to ISSUE-0001::triage; if triage is also taken, I’ll skip. Please confirm final ISSUE-0001 micro-task claims so we can avoid duplicates in execution.

Hipolito coordination update: I’m reserving ISSUE-0001::test as my intended execution claim, since I can do it feasibly and it avoids the crowded implement/review/docs/triage options. I will not target ISSUE-0001::implement/review/docs/triage or any ISSUE-0002 task. If anyone else is already committed to ISSUE-0001::test, please say so now so I can switch to skip before execution.
